# War Scroll Column 1 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 1 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1:1** For the Instructor, the rule of the war. The first attack of the Sons of Light shall be against the lot of the Sons of Darkness — against the army of Belial, against the forces of Edom, Moab, and the sons of Ammon,

**1:2** and the army of the inhabitants of Philistia, and against the forces of the Kittim of Asshur, and with them the violators of the covenant, allies in wickedness.

**1:3** The sons of Levi, Judah, and Benjamin, the exiles of the wilderness, shall wage war against them with [...] against all their forces, when the exiles of the Sons of Light return from the Wilderness of the Peoples

**1:4** to encamp in the Wilderness of Jerusalem. And after the war they shall march up from there [...] against the Kittim of Egypt.

**1:5** And in his time he shall go forth with great wrath to wage war against the kings of the north, and his anger shall seek to destroy and to shatter the power of

**1:6** [his enemies. This] shall be a time of salvation for the people of God, and an appointed time of dominion for all the men of his lot, and of everlasting destruction for all the lot of Belial.

**1:7** And there shall be great terror among the sons of Japheth, and Asshur shall fall with none to help him. And the dominion of the Kittim shall come to an end, and wickedness shall be brought low without

**1:8** any remnant — no survivor among the Sons of Darkness.

**1:9** And the Sons of Righteousness shall shine to all the ends of the earth, continuing to shine until all the appointed times of darkness are completed. And in the appointed time of God, his exalted greatness shall shine

**1:10** for all the ages of eternity — peace and blessing, glory and joy, and length of days for all the Sons of Light. And on the day the Kittim fall, there shall be battle and fierce destruction

**1:11** before the God of Israel, for that shall be the day he appointed from of old for the war of annihilation against the Sons of Darkness. On that day the congregation of the divine beings

**1:12** and the assembly of men shall clash together in great destruction. The Sons of Light and the lot of Darkness shall battle for the power of God,

**1:13** amid the shout of a great multitude and the war cry of divine beings and men, on the day of calamity. It shall be a time of distress for all the people redeemed by God.

**1:14** Of all their afflictions none shall compare to this, from its beginning until eternal redemption. And on the day of their battle against the Kittim, they shall go forth

**1:15** to war. In three lots the Sons of Light shall stand firm to strike down wickedness, and in three lots the army of Belial shall brace themselves to drive back the lot of [...]

**1:16** The infantry columns shall cause hearts to melt, but the power of God shall strengthen the heart of the Sons of Light. And in the seventh lot, the great hand of God shall bring low

**1:17** Belial and all the angels of his dominion, and all the men of his lot shall suffer everlasting destruction.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering of 1QM Column 1. Follows LOGOS for formal register while incorporating PNEUMA's clarity at key points. "Instructor" (EMET/LOGOS) preferred over "Teacher" (PNEUMA) as it better renders maskil. "Sons of Light/Darkness" retained as essential Qumran dualistic vocabulary. "Kittim" preserved untranslated. The seven-engagement structure (three victories for each side, divine intervention in the seventh) is the column's organizing principle.*
